## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] It does one thing, and is up to date with `main`
- [ ] I updated the docs (README / docs/) where behaviour, keys or outputs changed
- [ ] Any new numbers or charts are labelled **measured**, **calculated**, **synthetic** or **illustration**
- [ ] No recordings, logs, results or the face model are committed
- [ ] No new dependencies, or I explained why above
